checks.detail: L_down + L_up has 21 records, all plane-diagonal, and equals q I exactly (q = e_1 = sum_j 4 sin^2(k_j/2)); L_down L_up = 0. So on the fibre L_up = psi psi^dagger and |psi|^2 = q. For q > 0 the two kernels are complementary and Q = 1 - P_psi projects onto ker L_up. At Gamma q = 0, psi = 0: only the cleared identities apply, not the normalized projector
checks.name: for q > 0, Q projects onto ker L_up; the cleared Hodge identities hold everywhere
checks.suite: the Feshbach channel of the plaquette Hodge algebra

checks.detail: L_down psi = 0 exactly (homological protection, B^dagger psi = 0), L_up psi = q psi, S psi = -4 psi. All three are scalars on the carrier line, so Q L_down psi = Q L_up psi = Q S psi = 0: the Hodge algebra generates no Feshbach coupling at all

checks.detail: phi = q R psi - <psi, R psi> psi is not identically zero, is orthogonal to the carrier over the whole zone, and L_up phi = 0 record by record. Every excursion off the retained sector in this geometry is an R insertion, and it lands in the up-harmonic summand

checks.detail: 39 words of length <= 3 in (S, U, R); exactly 7 have a nonzero Feshbach defect: RR, RRR, RRS, RRU, RSR, SRR, URR. Every one of them contains two R insertions with no U between them, and every word with at most one R factorizes completely. RUR factorizes (L_up phi = 0) and RSR does not -- the rule is about the intermediate excursion, not about counting R's

checks.detail: every word with at most one R has carrier symbol (-4)^#S (-2)^#R q^(#U + 1 - #R) e_2^#R exactly, verified for lengths at most three as cleared Laurent identities. The U count matters: UR already has sigma = -2 q e_2, so R-degree alone does not exclude the B tier

checks.detail: in both cells ker L_down is one-dimensional and spanned by the face-sign carrier, L_down L_up = 0, and L_up psi = |psi|^2 psi (4 psi on the tetrahedron, 7 psi on the prism). So every word in the two Laplacians is scalar on the carrier in both. L_down + L_up is a scalar on the tetrahedron (4 I) and is NOT on the prism ([6, 6, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5]: five links on a cap, four on a side), so the link-regularity hypothesis is refuted as a requirement and the weaker eigenvector hypothesis suffices for scalar Hodge words. No proper-return calculation or general U3 conclusion is established in these two cells by this check
checks.name: the Hodge-word statement needs only L_down psi = 0 and L_up psi = lambda psi, and both hold in three geometries
checks.suite: the Feshbach channel of the plaquette Hodge algebra

checks.detail: the predicted bound holds in every case: n=3 kappa=0.678 |value|=0.007675 <= 0.07564; n=4 kappa=0.317 |value|=0.05662 <= 0.135; n=5 kappa=0.235 |value|=0.00602 <= 0.01274; n=6 kappa=0.325 |value|=0.003521 <= 0.01248. The constant uses only <R_0 w, w> and kappa -- no quantity evaluated on the interacting problem
checks.name: a relative form bound gives the explicit constant C = kappa/(1-|g|kappa)^2 <R_0 w,w>

checks.detail: kappa scales linearly with the interaction while the margin 1 - |g| kappa collapses: scale 1: kappa=0.32, margin=0.9968, scale 4: kappa=1.27, margin=0.9873, scale 16: kappa=5.08, margin=0.9492, scale 64: kappa=20.31, margin=0.7969, scale 256: kappa=81.23, margin=0.1877. The constant grows as margin^-2 (0.319 to 2306.0 across this family) and the bound is void once |g| kappa >= 1, where this bound no longer certifies positivity. Actual loss of positivity does not follow from failure of this sufficient criterion. So the identity moves the difficulty from an absolute bound on the interacting resolvent to a volume-uniform relative form bound, and does not supply the latter. G22 is where that debt is registered
checks.name: FINDING: the reduction buys a relative form bound, not the estimate -- void at |g| kappa >= 1

checks.detail: across n = 4..64 with a near-zero mode: kappa is 0.500000, 0.499999, 0.499995, 0.499983, 0.499968 (spread 3.14e-05, volume-independent) while ||R_0 V|| is 1.2, 2.5, 5.1, 10.2, 20.4 (a factor 16.9 across the same range, growing linearly). The quantity Neumann iteration needs diverges with the volume; the quantity the collapse identity needs does not, because a relative bound is a max over local terms and not a sum. One dimension, kinetic interaction: the mechanism, not a gauge statement
checks.name: the relative bound is volume-stable where the Neumann quantity is not
